key_insight: IndoNutriQA introduces an expert-curated benchmark for evaluating Indonesian clinical nutrition question answering in a low-resource language.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research toward Indonesian nutritional decision support, but does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Curated 911 question–answer pairs from real clinical nutrition reports, with structured metadata.
Used eight standardized Nutrition Care Process question types and free-form answers from nutritionists.
Evaluated fine-tuned baselines with 5-fold cross-validation and eight LLMs in zero- and five-shot settings.
evidence_signal: Expert validation found 6–10% of reference answers contestable; an LLM judge was human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety.
watch_item: Automated scoring missed unsupported content identified by human raters, underscoring the need for expert safety review.
paper_title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
